title: The Night the Forest Burned
first_cliffhanger: An unseen observer and a bell ring from a place without a tower; no fire origin reveal
character_rules: Original SHA-locked Ember; Moss no glasses, shell spiral, front-right crack; no new wardrobe or voices.

scenes.text: The first flames came before the thunder. Ember heard a cry from the smoke—and ran toward it.
scenes.direction: Dark forest twilight; flames at distance, fox racing over mossy roots, foreground smoke opens to reveal peril
Ember stops, ears sharply turn; he calls into smoke, ash settles on his scarf.

scenes.text: A burning branch fell across the trail. Ember leapt beneath it, searching for the voice.
scenes.direction: Massive gnarled tree falls across a wet ravine path; Ember dives under and lands in mud.

scenes.text: A little animal slipped free of the fire and vanished north. Ember turned back for the others.
scenes.direction: Scorched small woodland creature escapes at rear of frame; Ember watches then turns south against the fire.

scenes.text: What is that? Fire burns everything. Why isn't that feather burning?
scenes.direction: Real luminous blue feather caught in branches, its light spills onto Ember face and scarf.

scenes.text: The feather spun against the wind. One blue spark drew a path across the blackened earth.
scenes.direction: Feather ascends with trails over charred moss, its reflection flickers on muddy puddle.

scenes.text: Do not touch it, little fox. Some things survive a fire because they are warnings.
scenes.direction: Moss steps from ember-lit fog; ground shadows and shell depth, no glasses or new costume.

scenes.text: The sky was clear when this started. And the warning bell never rang.
scenes.direction: Ember and Moss in same detailed world under broken alarm rope, Ember speaks with disbelief.

scenes.text: Moss stared toward the river. A crack spread beneath the ash, silent until it reached their feet.
scenes.direction: Camera tracks fissure cracking across stone; real sparks and dust from ground; nearby roots shift.
Ember slips and catches a root above a deep ravine, scarf pulled taut by wind.

scenes.text: Look at me. Put your paw on the stone. Now reach.
scenes.direction: Moss anchors his shell and reaches down; Ember's real paws grip rock in synchronized shot.

scenes.text: One last pull brought Ember to safety. But the feather had already slipped into the smoke.
scenes.direction: Moss drags Ember to safety, tight meaningful shot; feather floats off into mist.

scenes.text: Someone wants us to follow. What if they started this?
scenes.direction: Ember looks down blue-lit fog tunnel; his eyes flick between Moss and the disappearing glow.

scenes.text: Thunder finally rolled. Beyond the burned woods, a bell rang where no tower stood.
scenes.direction: Cinematic panoramic forest silhouette, distant metallic bell sound from unexplained location, true moving mist.

scenes.text: Whoever you are, I know you're out there.
scenes.direction: Ember turns toward an owl-shaped shadow that vanishes into tree canopy; unresolved mystery ending.
